So the question 'what budget does the successor need' has a direct, measurable answer.

full_window_profile_fractional_bracket_p.definition: (persistence - noise_floor) / (synth_ceiling - noise_floor), per seed per window from arm_results[].windows[].control. 0.5 is the midpoint C2 tests against; 1.0 is the dense-synthetic-credit ceiling.

route_B_persistence.marginal_seeds_stated_explicitly: Red-team F2, verified and accepted. 'n_persistent = 0' is a true CLASSIFIER COUNT but must not be read as 'nothing is happening after update 300'. Seed 633's W4 is 0.0108 BELOW its midpoint while the W4 midpoint's own across-seed realisation spread is 0.0174 -- i.e. inside control-realisation noise of crossing. Seed 622's W4 sits 0.1654 ABOVE the pure-noise floor (39 percent of bracket) and is that seed's MOST directed window, on a profile that rises monotonically (-0.186 -> -0.046 -> +0.012 -> +0.390). The classifier has no label for 'late-rising', so that shape is invisible to C2's three-way scheme.
route_B_persistence.control_approximation: Red-team F2, second half. The window brackets are measured on FRESH-INIT heads over length L, while the real run's late windows step a mid-training Adam whose bias-corrected moments have settled. The driver records this as a known approximation (its defence: the pure-noise floor is invariant over gradient scale and moves with L, which the window matches). The DIRECTION of any residual bias is NOT MEASURED, and the controls are single realisations with no SE. So a genuine late persistent signal on the two marginal seeds could be masked by a mis-set W4 bracket. This is stated rather than assumed away, and it is why route A rather than route B is the primary basis for the recommendation.

H-learning-signal-sign.autopsy_reading: The run carries TWO readings of this leg that disagree, and the honest verdict is therefore NOT elimination. The LOAD-BEARING statistic (episode-level Pearson r on frozen-init-head labels, the redesign that fixed 1020's starvation) is a well-powered null excluding |r| > ~0.09 on 5/5 seeds. The RECORDED statistic (1020's trained-head drawn-sample difference of means) is negative on 4/5 in three variants, though with unstable per-seed membership and magnitudes within roughly 1 SE. A defensible case exists that the load-bearing statistic should win -- it was redesigned precisely because the recorded one starves and is confounded by early-P1 return trend -- but that case was NOT pre-registered as a tie-break, and eliminating a registered leg on it would be exactly the post-hoc move the frozen ledger exists to prevent. Recommended ledger state: ALIVE, with both readings recorded. See hypothesis_space_ledger_pending.

learning_extracted: 1. SEED IDENTITY IS DETERMINISTIC FOR THE PERSISTENCE CLASS, REPRODUCED THREE TIMES ACROSS TWO MACHINE CLASSES. 1028's W1 = [0,70] window reproduces V3-EXQ-1020's ARM_ON pooled persistence to within 2.5e-5 on the four seeds that realised all 70 updates (611 +5.1e-06, 633 +2.5e-05, 644 -3.2e-06, 655 -4.9e-06), and 1027's REPLAY_FAITHFUL arm is BIT-IDENTICAL to 1020's ARM_ON on all five. Stronger still, and under-claimed in this artifact's own draft: per-episode RETURNS are BIT-IDENTICAL between 1020 ARM_ON and 1028 for all 5 seeds over the first 70 P1 episodes, across linux-x86_64/py3.10-torch2.12.0+cpu and darwin-arm64/py3.13-torch2.12.0. Seed 622's persistence differs by -9.3e-03 and is the single seed that realised 69 of 70 updates in 1020/1027 (and 499 of 500 here), so its window covers a different update SET by one -- a mechanically explained exception on identical trajectories, not a divergence. The partition {622,633,644} below midpoint / {611,655} above is a fixed function of the seed.

2. THAT MAKES C2's MAJORITY RULE A STATEMENT ABOUT THE SEED SET, NOT THE POPULATION -- the flaw 1028's own driver diagnosed in 1020 and then inherited. Any successor reading persistence must pre-register SEED IDENTITY AS A FACTOR, report per-seed rather than a majority count, and either use enough seeds for a majority to mean something or drop the majority framing for a per-seed effect size.

3. THE BUDGET QUESTION IS ANSWERED BY CRITERION POWER, NOT BY A CEILING ARGUMENT -- and the two routes agree on 300. The durable, uncontested route is that the load-bearing C3 criterion needs >= 50 init-head flip ticks in each half of P1: at T=150 two seeds starve (45, 48), at T=200 all five score with a 1.08x margin, and at T=300 all five score with 1.40x. The persistence route agrees that a longer budget is not the lever (0 of 5 persistent in W4) but is reported with its limits and licenses NO refusal above 300. A budget recommendation grounded in what the criterion needs is more robust than one grounded in what the gradient stopped doing.

4. A 'FRACTION OF TOTAL DECAY COMPLETE BY T' STATISTIC CANNOT EVIDENCE A CEILING, BECAUSE IT FRONT-LOADS BY CONSTRUCTION. This artifact's own draft cited '86 percent of the flip-rate decay complete by episode 300' as corroboration; the Step 7c red team showed the statistic is an additive share denominated on the run's own endpoint and is front-loaded for ANY monotone decay toward an asymptote. In ratio terms the same data show a further 1.3x-13.2x reduction after episode 300. The claim was withdrawn. Generalisable: an additive share of a decay is not evidence about where the decay stops.

5. THE WINDOWING FIX MATTERED AND PREVENTED A FALSE UNANIMITY. Every seed's CUMULATIVE persistence at T = 500 sits below the cumulative midpoint (cumulative_below_midpoint_T true 5/5), so the endpoint read the queue-time red team's F1 replaced would have returned 5 of 5 'noisy'. The windowed read returns 3 noisy / 2 directed-then-exhausted. The controls confirm the drift the fix was built for: the synthetic ceiling falls from ~0.73 at L=70 to ~0.69-0.72 at L=500 while the noise floor falls from 0.449 to ~0.289.

6. C3's REDESIGN WORKED AS AN INSTRUMENT FIX, AND THE GENERALISABLE LESSON IS SHARP: A CRITERION WHOSE SAMPLE COUNT IS PRODUCED BY THE EFFECT UNDER TEST MUST BE LABELLED BY A FROZEN REFERENCE, NOT BY THE TRAINED OBJECT. 1020's C3 starved at 4 samples in the worst cell because trained flips extinguish; labelling every P1 episode's flips through a frozen copy of the cell's own init head removed that feedback loop and delivered 5/5 scoreable with 2.6x-6.9x headroom.

7. A RUN CAN CARRY TWO STATISTICS FOR ONE HYPOTHESIS THAT DISAGREE IN DIRECTION, AND WHICH ONE WINS MUST BE PRE-REGISTERED. 1028's load-bearing episode-level Pearson r reads null while the recorded 1020-style difference-of-means reads negative on 4 of 5 seeds (in three variants, though not the same 4). There are good design reasons to prefer the load-bearing one -- it was built to fix the other's starvation -- but no pre-registered tie-break exists, so the leg cannot be resolved on this run. Future fan-out drivers that retain a superseded statistic 'for comparability' should state in advance what happens when the two disagree.

8. THE LINEAGE'S BRAKE COUNT IS AN ARTEFACT OF THE 'amend' OVERLOAD, NOT OF A CEILING. SD-082's literal R1-R3 count is 5 with ZERO substrate_ceiling readings among them; every hit arrives through the direction fallback after action 'amend' disables the instrument-repair and producer-release escapes. A bookkeeping amend is indistinguishable to the predicate from an amend that owes a build. Flagged to /governance; no fix proposed here.
